title: Build A (the data backbone) is ready to merge

owner_note.text: Branch worktree/backbone: saved items now write which list they belong to, every old file still replays the same (9,615 of 9,616; the one difference is a bug fix), and the biggest voice session loads in about 130 ms instead of about 1 s. A fresh review's 15 findings are answered; merging will give a small conflict in core/Item/Item.js with build B.
